description:
At Card Guardian, we are dedicated to providing premium storage and protection solutions for trading card enthusiasts. Whether you are a collector of Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, or sports cards, our products—ranging from premium deck boxes and binders to high-clarity sleeves—are designed to keep your collection in mint condition. We combine sleek aesthetics with durable engineering to ensure your cards stay safe, organized, and ready for battle.

• What makes us different

We don't just make storage; we make vaults for your hobby.

  • Premium Quality: We use high-grade materials like archival-safe, acid-free, non-PVC polypropylene.

  • Community-Centric: Designed by collectors, for collectors. We understand the value (both sentimental and financial) of your cards.

  • Style Meets Function: Our gear looks as good on a shelf as it does on a tournament table, offering a sophisticated look that stands out from generic plastic cases.

• How affiliates can earn

We believe in rewarding our partners for their influence. As a Card Guardian affiliate:

  • Earn 10% Commission: You will receive a 10% commission on the total sale value for every order generated using your unique discount code.

  • Exclusive Discounts: Your followers get a deal, and you get paid—it’s a win-win.

  • No Earning Cap: The more you promote and the more your audience grows, the more you earn. There is no limit to your commissions.

• How to promote us

We want you to share Card Guardian in a way that feels authentic to your style. You are encouraged to promote us across:

  • Social Media: Create engaging content on TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram.

  • Content Types: Show off your latest "pulls" in our binders, do a "shake test" with our deck boxes, or share a "What’s in my bag" video featuring Card Guardian gear.

  • Live Streams: Mention your code during your Twitch or YouTube breaks while you’re gaming or opening packs.

• Other information

  • Tracking & Transparency: Access a dedicated dashboard to track your sales, clicks, and earnings in real-time.

  • Support: Our team is here to provide you with high-res assets and product information to help you succeed.

  • Global Reach: We ship worldwide, meaning your audience can shop from almost anywhere.
